prerequisites: None, but a good performance in Mathematics and
module_outcomes: Know the SI system of units for physical quantities and be able to use the correct symbols for any units;
Understand and be able to use some basic statistical concepts as they apply to a physical measurement;
Be familiar with the terminology and concepts used in basic Mechanics;
Understand the basic laws of Mechanics and know the more important definitions;
Be able to derive some relationships important to the study of Mechanics;
Be able to identify where the laws and definitions and derived relationships apply, especially in problems based on real life;
Be able to do calculations and solve problems of a mechanics nature.
Understand and be able to use the theory describing wave motion to explain phenomena of sound and light waves. Use it to solve problems;
Know what is understood by the concept of heat, know the laws related to the transfer of heat and be able to solve problems on heat and heat transfer;
Know the basic principles of geometrical optics and be able to draw ray diagrams to explain refraction and reflection and the operation of thin lenses.
